tile.marked: Goes along with the face when the avatar is used

chat.button: Avatars: one person in many pictures
chat.callAbout: Write {'@'} and the avatar's name in any request: its face and marked photos go along with the request.

modal.title: Avatars
modal.text: An avatar is one person who looks the same in every picture and video. First the app writes a description of the person, then draws a face, then a set of 36 shots: angles, poses, emotions.
modal.attached: {n} picture is attached in this chat. Add it to the photos of {name}? | {n} pictures are attached in this chat. Add them to the photos of {name}?
modal.name: Name
modal.nameHint: Short and without spaces is best: you will call the avatar by this name in requests.
modal.createAttached: Use the {n} picture attached in the chat as a photo of the person | Use the {n} pictures attached in the chat as photos of the person
modal.createFree: Creating is free. Google is paid only when you press a button with a price.

reference.name: From photos
reference.text: You upload photos of a real person; the avatar looks like them.

description.name: From a description
description.text: You describe the person in words; the photos are not needed.

auto.name: Made up
auto.text: The model makes up a new person. A few words about who they are help, but are not required.

card.archiveAsk: Move {name} to the archive? Pictures stay, the avatar can be restored.
card.archivedText: The avatar is in the archive: nothing can be drawn for it until it is restored.

person.briefPlaceholder: For example, a woman about 30, short dark hair, calm and friendly
person.briefNeeded: Required here: the description is written from these words.
person.briefOptional: Not required. It helps the model with what the photos do not show.

photos.title: Photos of the person: {n} of {max}
photos.textReference: The description is written from the first {n} photos. Put the clearest ones first.
photos.textOther: Photos are not needed here, but you can keep some for reference.
photos.marked: Marked photos (up to {n} together with the face) go along with the avatar when it is used.
photos.angle: What is in the photo, for example «left side»
photos.mark: Mark: send along with the face
photos.removeAsk: Remove this photo from the avatar? The file stays in the media library.

identity.title: Description
identity.text: A description of the person in English. Every picture of the avatar is drawn from it.
identity.shortHint: Add details: face, hair, eyes, skin, build. The more exact, the more alike the pictures.
identity.empty: No description yet. Let the model write it, or write it yourself.
identity.unlockAsk: Unlock the description? It can then be changed, and new pictures may come out different from the old ones.
identity.replaceAsk: Write the description again? The current text will be replaced.
identity.sends: {n} photo is sent to Google | {n} photos are sent to Google
identity.sendsText: Only the words about the person are sent to Google.
identity.lockedText: The description is locked so that the face does not change. Unlock it to edit.

candidates.text: Google draws a few faces from the description. Pick the one you like: every shot will be drawn from it.
candidates.modelText: Applies to the faces and all shots of this avatar.
candidates.sends: {n} photo of the person is sent along | {n} photos of the person are sent along
candidates.title: Faces drawn: {n}
candidates.replaceAsk: Make this the face? The description gets locked; shots already drawn stay, but may differ from the new face.
candidates.pickAsk: Make this the face? The description gets locked so that the face does not change.

pack.failed: {n} shot did not work out | {n} shots did not work out
pack.stopAsk: Stop drawing? Pictures already drawn stay.
pack.twoAtOnce: two pictures are drawn at a time
pack.asSubjectOff: Off: the avatar can not be called by name.
pack.asSubjectOn: Write {'@'}{name} in any request: the face and marked photos go along.
pack.asSubjectWait: Will work once the face is chosen.
pack.skipped: {n} shot was not started. | {n} shots were not started.

grid.title: Shots of {name}
grid.chooseHint: Tick the shots to draw again. The old pictures stay for comparison.
grid.redrawChosen: Draw {n} shot again | Draw {n} shots again

slot.title: {n}. {title}
slot.faceText: The first shot is the face itself. To change it, choose another face on the «Face» step.
slot.busyText: Being drawn now. You can close this window.
slot.promptHint: In English, what the shot shows. The description of the person is added on its own.
slot.promptResetAsk: Return the standard prompt for this shot?
slot.redrawText: The old picture stays: compare it with the new one above.
slot.fixPlaceholder: For example, make the smile softer
slot.fixText: Google gets this picture and your words, and changes only what you asked.
slot.removeAsk: Remove the picture from this shot? The shot stays empty and can be drawn again.
slot.markText: Marked shots go along with the avatar when it is used: up to {max} pictures together with the face.

batch.fromBrief: From the words about the person
batch.identityEnglish: In English: models follow it more exactly.
batch.identityOld: The avatar has another description now.
batch.notApplied: The description was locked while it was being written, so the new text was not put in.
batch.stopAsk: Stop the pictures of this message? Pictures already drawn stay.
batch.failedHint: Open the shot to see why and draw it again.
batch.packTitle: Set of {n} shot | Set of {n} shots
batch.finishTitle: The remaining {n} shot | The remaining {n} shots

shots.SHOT_34: Head down, eyes to the camera
shots.SHOT_35: Head up, eyes to the camera

errors.avatar_brief_too_long: The words about the person are too long: up to {max} characters.
errors.avatar_describe_busy: The description is already being written. Wait or stop it.
errors.avatar_face_slot: The first shot is the face itself: change it on the «Face» step.
errors.avatar_fix_too_long: The fix is too long: up to {max} characters.
errors.avatar_identity_empty: The description is too short: at least {min} characters.
errors.avatar_identity_exists: The avatar already has a description. Confirm to replace it.
errors.avatar_identity_locked: The description is locked. Unlock it first.
errors.avatar_identity_too_long: The description is too long: up to {max} characters.
errors.avatar_mark_not_allowed: The face always goes along with the avatar; it needs no mark.
errors.avatar_mode_unknown: Unknown way of making an avatar.
errors.avatar_no_brief: Write a few words about the person first.
errors.avatar_no_photos: Add at least one photo of the person.
errors.avatar_no_picture: This shot has no picture yet.
errors.avatar_photo_busy: This picture is being drawn right now.
errors.avatar_photo_foreign: This picture belongs to another avatar.
errors.avatar_photo_limit: No more than {max} photos of the person.
errors.avatar_photos_unreadable: The photos could not be read. Upload them again.
errors.avatar_prompt_too_long: The prompt is too long: up to {max} characters.
errors.stuck: Drawing hung and was stopped. Try again.
errors.interrupted: The app was restarted during the work. Try again.
errors.bad_order: The list of photos has changed. Refresh the page.
